annotations.title: Plan a fix for AI visibility

description: An exact plan for one Kliqo action (from get_actions or get_briefing), or for one page: what to change and where, the questions buyers ask that the page should answer, the competitors and sites AI uses instead, and the page's current problems (crawler access, text without JavaScript, title, structured data, dates). In a code editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), apply the plan in the site's code, then call verify_fix. Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).

action_id.description: The action to plan (from get_actions or get_briefing)

project.description: Project name, domain or id; leave out for the workspace's current project

url.description: A page to plan for, when there is no action
